annotations.title: List border crossings near a place

description: Use this when the person asks what crossings are around a place or around them. Not for which one to take: use find_best_crossing. Answers the border crossings and airports nearest a town or crossing named in near, or lat and lon, each with its distance in km and its car lane's wait now; at most 20.

near.description: a town or a crossing: Lviv, Medyka, Tijuana
